parsed.notes:
I read the heading 'Das wünschen wir uns' ('what we would like') as the standard German requirements heading, not as an optional marker. Under rule 1 its unmarked items default to required.
I treated 'vorzugsweise' (preferably), 'wünschenswert' (desirable) and 'idealerweise' (ideally) as inline optional markers that make the item nice_to_have.
Azure: its only qualification mentions are marked optional ('vorzugsweise auf Microsoft Azure' and the 'idealerweise' AI bullet), so it is nice_to_have. Its other mentions are in responsibilities only.
Azure OpenAI is mapped to openai-api (uncertain), with Azure collapsed into the azure criterion.
I did not label 'Interesse an KI-Anwendungen' (interest in AI applications) as ai-ml, because interest is not a skill ask.
I labeled observability from the willingness to share responsibility for 'Logging, Monitoring' and flagged it uncertain. I did not label Deployment, because no generic deployment skill id fits.
I mapped 'Automatisierungslösungen' (automation solutions) to workflow-automation and flagged it uncertain.
I mapped 'Frontend-Framework' to frontend-development as the broad skill the text names, and flagged it uncertain.
I did not label 'Webanwendungen' (web applications) separately, because full-stack-development is already labeled.
The tech in the responsibilities section ('Das erwartet Sie') is skipped unless the candidate is also asked for it.
Seniority: 'Mehrjährige' means 'several years', which gives no exact count. I read it as 'proven experience', so mid, inferred and uncertain. 'erfahrene' (experienced) alone is not a level signal.
Degree: 'oder eine vergleichbare, durch praktische Erfahrung erworbene Qualifikation' accepts experience in place of the degree, so degree_or_equivalent is true.
